name: mslk-rocm-review
description: Independent, read-only reviewer for MSLK changes on the ROCm side: guards and fallback, kernel memory safety, CUDA graphs, tests and tolerances, ROCm CI wiring, performance, aiter integration.

container.title: Dev container
container.description: Name of your running MSLK dev container (docker), e.g. alice_mslk

repo_in_container.title: Repo path in the container
repo_in_container.description: Where your MSLK checkout is mounted inside the container, e.g. /workspace/MSLK

home_in_container.title: Home path in the container
home_in_container.description: Where your host home directory is mounted inside the container, e.g. /mnt/host_home

scratch_dir.title: Probe directory (host)
scratch_dir.description: Host directory under your home for the reviewer's probe scripts, never inside the repo, e.g. ~/scratch/review

python_setup.title: Python setup command
python_setup.description: Shell command run in the container before Python, e.g. export PATH=/opt/venv/bin:$PATH

aiter_source.title: aiter source path in the container

lint_bin.title: Lint tools directory in the container
lint_bin.description: Directory holding ufmt and flake8, e.g. /opt/lintenv/bin
